title: Luca needs to understand GenAI
message: One student’s learning process, from assignment to assessment
body: Luca is a second-year computer science student: he can program, but still confuses key concepts of generative models.
He must study a chapter and explain how a small application generates text.
We observe his use of tools and the evidence of understanding he keeps.
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.
decision: You are following the learning method; you do not need to learn programming.

title: Assisted performance and learning
message: One study separates what happens during and after assistance
body: High-school mathematics, nearly 1,000 students in one Turkish school; not a trial of these tools.
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

comparison.label: With AI assistance
comparison.text: In Bastani and colleagues’ trial, assisted practice performance improved.

comparison.label: Later, without AI
comparison.text: The general-chat group performed below the control; instructional safeguards largely mitigated that harm.

decision: Workshop design choice: keep a brief independent assessment as well.

title: Read the formula from the chapter
message: Softmax with temperature · identify the role of each symbol
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

steps.title: zᵢ · score
steps.text: A number calculated by the model for candidate token i.

steps.title: T · temperature
steps.text: A positive setting that rescales scores before conversion.

steps.title: pᵢ · probability
steps.text: The exponentiated score divided by the sum over all candidates.

decision: The denominator makes the probabilities sum to one. Probability is not truth.

title: A short symbol guide
message: Read the notation before asking for another explanation
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

steps.title: i and j · candidates
steps.text: i identifies the candidate being considered; j runs over all candidates in the denominator.

steps.title: exp(a) · a positive weight
steps.text: This means e raised to a. Apply it to each score divided by the positive temperature.

steps.title: Σ · add the weights
steps.text: Sum all candidate weights, then divide each weight by this common total.

decision: The three-candidate example shows the same arithmetic on a deliberately small vocabulary.

title: Rubric: concepts and relationships
message: Criterion 1 · four levels of evidence
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

steps.title: 1 · Needs reconstruction
steps.text: Confuses training and inference, or treats probabilities as truth.

steps.title: 2 · Partial
steps.text: Names concepts, but incompletely relates parameters and context.

steps.title: 3 · Coherent
steps.text: Distinguishes phases and states correct relationships.

steps.title: 4 · Justified
steps.text: Justifies relationships and identifies conditions and limits in a new example.

decision: Apply the criterion to meaning in the agreed response mode.

title: Rubric: process explanation
message: Criterion 2 · make the links between stages explicit
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

steps.title: 1 · Absent
steps.text: Repeats output without describing the stages.

steps.title: 2 · Fragmentary
steps.text: Describes some stages but leaves gaps or reversals.

steps.title: 3 · Ordered
steps.text: Connects input, tokens, processing, distribution and selection.

steps.title: 4 · Justified
steps.text: Explains the links and separates the diagram from observed data.

decision: A commented diagram or oral explanation can reveal the same process.

title: Rubric: application and checking
message: Criterion 3 · predict, test and revise
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

steps.title: 1 · Unjustified
steps.text: States a conclusion without a prediction or check.

steps.title: 2 · Incomplete
steps.text: Predicts, but changes multiple conditions or does not compare outcomes.

steps.title: 3 · Controlled
steps.text: Varies one condition, compares the outcome and corrects an error.

steps.title: 4 · Critical
steps.text: Justifies revision and recognises sampling, limitations and uncertainty.

decision: Do not reward a lucky outcome from one generation.

title: Prepare questions and expected answers
message: The first question checks a fundamental distinction
body: Q1 · During ordinary inference, what changes when a new prompt is entered? A: original training data. B: calculation context. C: learned parameters.
Expected: B, with justification; a correct choice alone provides limited evidence.
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.
prompt: Generate five chapter-based questions: distinction, explanation, diagram, prediction and transfer. For each, provide the expected answer, a detectable misconception and the rubric criterion. Avoid questions answered by copying a definition.
decision: A teacher-reviewed teaching example, not a validated test.

title: Explanation and diagram completion
message: Questions 2 and 3 · observe the connections
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

comparison.label: Q2 · Explain
comparison.text: Why does a token not always match a word? Expected: encoding may split words or represent other sequence elements.

comparison.label: Q3 · Complete a diagram
comparison.text: Complete text → tokens → model → distribution → selection. What repeats? Expected: the selected token joins the context and calculation continues.

decision: Read correctness and explanation without requiring code.

title: Prediction and transfer
message: Questions 4 and 5 · apply a concept and recognise an error
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

comparison.label: Q4 · Predict
comparison.text: Same input and scores: what changes from T = 0.5 to T = 1.2? Expected: less concentrated probabilities, without a guarantee about one sampled token.

comparison.label: Q5 · Correct an error
comparison.text: “The most probable alternative will be true”. Refute using a new example. Expected: token plausibility differs from content truth.

decision: Keep the initial prediction, test outcome and justified revision.

title: Formative: set up the assessment
message: One collection point, with clear instructions and available criteria
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

steps.title: Create the activity
steps.text: State the goal and when materials are allowed or chat must be closed.

steps.title: Add five questions
steps.text: Use multiple choice, open response and drawing in the Free plan.

steps.title: Prepare the review
steps.text: Key for Q1; teacher review for explanations and diagrams.

decision: Use the standalone kit rubric; no premium integration is needed.

title: Choose the format for the evidence
message: Three response types, three opportunities to observe
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

comparison.label: Multiple choice + reason
comparison.text: Identify a distinction and inspect the reasoning.

comparison.label: Open response
comparison.text: Observe explanations, predictions and corrections.

comparison.label: Drawing + commentary
comparison.text: Make the sequence and relationships visible.

decision: Integrated audio/video responses are paid features; agree alternatives when needed.

title: Read three simulated responses
message: Invented examples for discussing teacher judgement
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

comparison.label: Profile A · complete product
comparison.text: The app works, but the explanation says every prompt updates parameters.

comparison.label: Profile B · vocabulary present
comparison.text: Names tokens and probabilities, but omits the link between distribution and selection.

comparison.label: Profile C · coherent explanation
comparison.text: Distinguishes phases, justifies a prediction and recognises the limit of one generation.

decision: Read differences criterion by criterion before summarising with a grade.

title: Feedback that specifies the next action
message: Teacher-written examples address the observed difficulty
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

comparison.label: For profile A
comparison.text: Revisit parameters versus context. Correct the arrow and explain why.

comparison.label: For profile B
comparison.text: Add the selection rule between distribution and token. Explain the link.

comparison.label: For profile C
comparison.text: Transfer your explanation to a new context and identify what remains uncertain.

decision: Teacher-written feedback in the Free plan, followed by a new learner attempt.

title: Activity: adapt an assessment
message: Five minutes on your subject and an access barrier
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

steps.title: Choose a goal · 1 minute
steps.text: Name a concept you teach or study.

steps.title: Design evidence · 2 minutes
steps.text: Write a task and observable criterion, allowing AI to produce the initial product.

steps.title: Remove a barrier · 2 minutes
steps.text: Offer an equivalent access or response option; share the reason for your choice.

decision: A reusable example with a coherent goal, evidence and support.

title: Accessibility and learning differences
message: Start with the barrier in the actual task, with the learner
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

comparison.label: Reading and fatigue
comparison.text: Adaptable text, read aloud, segments and pauses.

comparison.label: Writing the response
comparison.text: Dictation, review or another agreed response mode.

comparison.label: Organisation and calculation
comparison.text: A visible plan, glossary, diagrams and goal-aligned supports.

decision: Dyslexia and other specific learning difficulties vary; attention needs are distinct. No typeface or tool fits everyone.

title: Edge: another way to read the same chapter
message: Access to the text and understanding require separate checks
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

steps.title: Open the chapter HTML
steps.text: Use Reading mode on a supported page or selected passage.

steps.title: Adapt and listen
steps.text: Try text preferences and Read aloud; adjust the speed.

steps.title: Check usefulness
steps.text: Pause at the paragraph and explain the relationship you read.

decision: Read aloud supports access; understanding still needs a learner attempt.

title: Notebook: short segments and a glossary
message: Adapt presentation while checking that meaning is preserved
body: Compare each segment with the original; choose the appropriate detail with the learner.
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.
prompt: Rewrite this paragraph in three short segments. Define token, context and parameters. Preserve the condition “during inference” and flag each simplification. Do not remove essential relationships.
decision: A brief explanation helps when it preserves the concept’s conditions.

title: Dictation: express and review an answer
message: Speech produces text that the learner must check
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

steps.title: Configure Dictation
steps.text: On Mac: System Settings → Keyboard → Dictation; choose language and activation.

steps.title: Dictate into the answer field
steps.text: Explain the role of context.

steps.title: Read and revise
steps.text: Check technical terms, negations and punctuation before submitting.

decision: Windows offers voice typing; check availability and settings on the actual device.

title: An accessible assessment of the same goal
message: Change the mode while preserving the evidence sought
body: Goal: explain the generation process, rather than writing speed.
Possible agreed responses: reviewed text, oral explanation or commented diagram.
Clear instructions, advance criteria and supports aligned with the task.
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.
decision: Apply the same conceptual criteria, using response arrangements appropriate to the educational context.

title: Reuse the learning path in another subject
message: Keep the sequence; change the content and evidence
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

steps.title: Start with a source and a goal
steps.text: For example: understand a historical interpretation from an assigned chapter.

steps.title: Make ideas visible
steps.text: Record an initial explanation, uncertainties and a manageable plan.

steps.title: Use tools, then check
steps.text: Compare a generated explanation with the source and revise relationships.

steps.title: Demonstrate and reflect
steps.text: Explain a new example independently; identify the next learning step.

decision: Choose a tool for a specific need and decide what evidence it should leave.

title: The evidence collected along the way
message: A product and an explanation answer different assessment needs
notes: Sequenza didattica originale del workshop. Le risposte e le scelte dello studente sono esempi costruiti, salvo risultati di esecuzione espressamente indicati come registrati.

comparison.label: Learning process
comparison.text: Initial map, selected plan, checked passage and revised map.

comparison.label: Assisted product
comparison.text: Diagram, application, recorded tests and revision history.

comparison.label: Demonstrated knowledge
comparison.text: Independent explanation, prediction, error correction and reflection.

decision: Compare these records before deciding what the learner needs next.

title: Free tools for planning and source-based study

comparison.text: Break down a task. Use Magic ToDo; paid mobile apps and Pro are optional.

comparison.label: Gemini Notebook · free Standard
comparison.text: Study selected sources and check citations. Google account; variable usage limits.

comparison.label: Excalidraw · free editor
comparison.text: Build and revise relationships. No account required for the editor.

decision: Free access does not always mean no account or unlimited AI use.

comparison.label: Transformers.js + Qwen · local demo
